headline: Find out how you can access the Christmas Brisita
summary: The Dominican government said it will deliver 2,753,781 Christmas bonuses of RD$1,500 through direct transfers and cards, as part of the Brisita Navideña programme.
why: Large state cash transfers inject household spending into the domestic economy, particularly around the end-of-year holiday period.
original_headline: Infórmate sobre cómo puedes tener acceso a la Brisita Navideña
